summary: Implementation plan for Her Little Arcade covering: (1) Sidebar invisible-scrollbar and overflow fix, (2) Profile Picture upload with interactive crop/preview and persistent storage, (3) 3-layer independent customization (Profile Picture + Animated Skin Avatar Frame + Rectangular Profile Banner), (4) 5-rarity Profile Banners catalog, (5) 5-tier Chest & Custom Key system obtainable via Coins and Daily/Weekly/Monthly Challenges, (6) Tier-distinct GSAP card-drawing chest opening animations with server-authoritative drops and duplicate-to-coin conversion, and (7) Unified 4-tab Inventory (Skins, Banners, Chests, Keys).
